caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on cream-colored paper and shows two detailed views of a single spoon, both oriented horizontally across the central portion of the page. The top view displays the convex side of the spoon with a bowl-shaped end tapering to a thin handle, which widens slightly and features ornate script near the handle's end. The bottom view shows the concave side of the same spoon; the bowl appears similarly tapered, and the handle's underside includes two rectangular stamps near the end. In the lower left corner, there is an inset technical diagram with measurements illustrating the outline, profile, and proportions of the spoon at a reduced scale, labeled "SCALE: ¼ = 1". The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner, outside the main drawing's border. The background is blank, and the composition uses shades of gray for shading and dimension.
title: Silver Spoon
